info.flavor: With a history stretching back to the earliest days of pre-Fall armored warfare, the tank remains a core component of modern military doctrine even in the era of mechanized combat chassis. Despite countless technological advances, the overall design of the modern main battle tank (or MBT) remains immediately recognizable: an armored vehicle housing a large, turreted primary weapon supplemented by secondary armaments, blending firepower, protective countermeasures, and mobility into a multipurpose unit capable of both offensive and defensive maneuvers. While chassis tend to be much more flexible and configurable strike platforms, tanks make up for this with the ability to mount heavier armor without compromising their ability to employ large-caliber weaponry on the move. The sheer variety of tank configurations that can be found throughout the galaxy is perhaps more diverse than even chassis variants, with different states, militaries, and even private armies all favoring models suited their preferred combat doctrines.
info.tactics: The MBT is a heavily armed and armored “set-piece” unit that can quickly overwhelm enemies with its combination of speed and firepower. It can quickly deal a tremendous amount of damage using Barrage with its main gun and secondary weapon as well as by using Tank Shock to run over other characters, and Composite Armor makes it incredibly resilient. These advantages must be balanced with both the restrictions to its movement and its visible armored facing, which make it vulnerable to being flanked. Choosing when to fire from range and when to press the attack are key to getting the most out of this unit
info.terse: The MBT is a heavily armed and armored unit that can quickly overwhelm enemies with its combination of speed and firepower, but it’s vulnerable to being flanked.

name: Rolling Thunder
effect: The MBT can't take the Grunt Template, and only a single MBT may be present in any scene

name: Full Tracked
effect: The MBT must always move in a straight line, although it can move and Boost in separate directions. Additionally, the MBT can’t climb, swim, manipulate objects, or make melee attacks other than Ram, but it ignores difficult terrain and has Immunity to Prone.

name: Armament Loadout
effect: The MBT chooses one Main Gun and one Secondary Gun.

name: Composite Armor
effect: One side of the MBT is an armored facing (choose one side of its token/icon/miniature). All characters can identify this facing. Attacks and effects that trace a line directly to this facing treat the MBT as though it has Armor 6 and Resistance to damage from Blast, Burst, Line, and Cone attacks and effects. AP damage, burn, and damage taken by the MBT while it is Shredded are all still reduced by 2 when coming from attacks and effects made against this facing. Mines and other proximity-based systems ignore this trait. Whenever the MBT makes a standard move or Boost, it can change which side its armored facing is on.

name: Tank Shock
effect: The MBT ignores engagement and can pass through, but not stop in, spaces occupied by other characters and obstructions smaller than Size 3. The MBT destroys any objects it passes through this way, and if it passes through any characters, those characters are pushed out of the way as directly as possible if able. Passing through characters as part of a Boost also means those characters must, 1/turn, pass a Hull save or take {4/5/6} Kinetic Damage and be knocked Prone.

name: Stable Body
effect: The MBT can’t be pushed, pulled, or knocked back by smaller characters. If a hostile effect would move the MBT 2 or more spaces or knock it Prone (even if the MBT would ignore that effect due to Immunity or movement caused by a smaller character) that character may change which side its armored facing is on after that effect resolves. Characters may also Ram the MBT to change which side its armored facing is on regardless of their Size.

name: Smoothbore Cannon
effect: This weapon deals {10/20/30} AP Explosive Damage to objects, cover, and terrain.

on_miss.detail: A Size 1 section of any object adjacent to the target (e.g., cover, deployable equipment, buildings, or terrain), takes {10/20/30} Explosive Damage.

on_crit.detail: The target becomes Shredded until the end of their next turn.

name: "Streetsweeper" Canister Projector
effect: This attack’s Cone area cannot change directions when fired.

name: Pindle-Mounted Machine Gun
effect: This weapon can attack two targets at a time.

on_hit.detail: The target must pass a Systems save or gain Lock On and become Impaired until the end of their next turn.

If the target is flying, they must pass an Agility save or choose one:
  • They take +1d6 bonus damage.
  • They immediately land (this counts as falling without any damage) and become unable to fly until the end of their next turn.

name: Multidirectional Charges
effect: This weapon ignores penalties from Engaged.

name: Hover Tank
effect: The MBT ignores dangerous terrain, and its movement no longer needs to be in a straight line.

name: Mobile Bunker
effect: Adjacent allied characters can use the MBT for hard cover. Characters gain Resistance to damage from Blast, Burst, Line, and Cone attacks while benefiting from this cover.

name: Secondary Gunner
effect: The MBT may make attacks with its Secondary Weapon even while Jammed or Stunned.

name: Siege Mode
effect: The MBT extends (or retracts) stabilizers that cause it to become Immobilized as long as this system is active. While extended, the MBT’s Main Gun gains Arcing and +5 Range (+5 Line if it is a Line weapon), but the MBT cannot make ranged attacks against or centered on characters, objects, or spaces within Range 3 using its Main Gun

actions.name: Siege Mode
actions.detail: The MBT extends (or retracts) stabilizers that cause it to become Immobilized as long as this system is active. While extended, the MBT's Main Gun gains Arcing and +5 Range (+5 Line if it is a Line weapon), but the MBT cannot make ranged attacks against or centered on characters, objects, or spaces within Range 3 using its Main Gun.

add_special.detail: While Siege Mode is active, the MBT's Main Gun gains +5 Range (or +5 Line if it is a Line weapon) but cannot make ranged attacks against or centered on characters, objects, or spaces within Range 3.

actions.name: Smokescreen
actions.effect: The MBT creates a Blast 2 area of dense, sensor-jamming smoke within Range 5, and may immediately Boost into it as a free action. This area lasts until the end of the MBT’s next turn, and all characters and objects within it gain soft cover. The first time the MBT and any allied characters enter this area, they clear Lock On.
